title: ZX Spectrum loading screen
description: A tape's loading screen: the picture, and the order its character-cell rectangles are sent in -- which, for a loader that sends a screen in pieces, is the order the picture appears in. The tape designer draws it; a *.tape.json names it.

meta.description: About the file rather than the screen. The builder ignores all of it.

comment.description: Prose for whoever opens the file.

picture.description: The .scr, .sna, .z80, .tap or .tzx the screen comes from, relative to this file.

order.description: The rectangles, in the order they are sent: x and w in character columns, y and h in character rows.
